# AlcoholDetectionDataset audit (generated by training/prepare_dataset.py)

> **Use limitation.** Each class is one recording of one person (no subject/session metadata,
> undocumented labels). Test results measure later frames of the *same* recordings, not new people,
> and cannot support any claim about detecting alcohol in general. Never report them as BAC or
> intoxication accuracy.

- Images: 394 readable / 394 total; corrupt: 0
- Per class: {'non_alcoholic': 197, 'alcoholic': 197}; formats {'png': 394}; resolutions {'227x227': 394}
- Exact duplicate files: 0
- Subject metadata: none (no subject or session identifiers in the dataset)
- Sessions: one continuous recording per class (frame-number sequences, near-identical frames)
- Face detection: {'ok': 394}; quality: {'ok': 394} {}
- Split (per-class contiguous blocks in recording order (0.7, 0.15, 0.15), 5 frames dropped at each boundary): {'train': {'non_alcoholic': 133, 'alcoholic': 133}, 'val': {'non_alcoholic': 19, 'alcoholic': 19}, 'test': {'non_alcoholic': 25, 'alcoholic': 25}, 'buffer': {'non_alcoholic': 20, 'alcoholic': 20}, 'excluded': {}}
